title: 单词搜索
statement: 给定 m × n 字符网格 board 和字符串 word，判断 word 能否由网格中一条路径上的字母依次拼出：路径上相邻两格必须上下或左右相邻，同一格在一条路径中最多使用一次。能则返回 true，否则返回 false。

en.title: Word Search
en.statement: Given an m × n character grid board and a string word, decide whether word can be spelled out letter by letter along a path in the grid: consecutive cells on the path must be vertically or horizontally adjacent, and a cell may be used at most once in a single path. Return true if possible, otherwise false.
constraints: board and word consist only of uppercase and lowercase English letters (case-sensitive)

complexity.time: O(m·n·3^L) worst case (local training target; L is the length of word, and every step after the first has at most 3 directions)
complexity.space: O(L) extra space (recursion stack, counted; visited cells are marked in place, input not counted)
complexity.officialRequirement: No official complexity requirement; the follow-up asks whether search pruning can make the solution faster on larger grids.
complexity.notes: m and n are the grid's row and column counts. Common pruning: compare letter counts first and return false immediately if the grid lacks enough of some letter; if word's last letter occurs less often in the grid, reverse word before searching. The local worst-case test is a 6 × 6 all-'A' grid with a long word ending in a letter absent from the grid, where unpruned backtracking must explore a huge number of paths.

en.acmIoSpec: stdin: line 1 is m; then m lines, each a string of n letters giving one row of the grid; the last line is word. stdout: true or false.

constraints: board 与 word 仅由大小写英文字母组成（区分大小写）

complexity.time: O(m·n·3^L) 最坏情况（本地训练目标；L 为 word 长度，除第一步外每步至多 3 个方向）
complexity.space: O(L) 额外空间（递归栈，计入递归栈；原地标记已访问格子，输入不计入）
complexity.officialRequirement: 官方未强制复杂度要求；follow-up 询问能否通过搜索剪枝让解法在更大的网格上更快。
complexity.notes: m、n 为网格行列数。常见剪枝：先比较字母计数，网格中某字母数量不足直接返回 false；若 word 末字母在网格中出现得更少，则反转 word 再搜索。本地最坏测试为 6 × 6 全 'A' 网格配合以网格中不存在的字母结尾的长单词，未剪枝的回溯需遍历大量路径。

cpp.acmIoSpec: stdin：第一行 m；随后 m 行，每行一个长度为 n 的字母串，表示网格的一行；最后一行为 word。stdout：true 或 false。
